item.title: Pixels launches community hub for player-built games, tools and voting
item.summary: Pixels has launched a new community development website designed to bring player-created projects, feature requests and development bounties into one central platform. The Pixels Community website follows the release of the game’s client and backend as open-source software, providing a formal route through which developers can share their work, players can request and vote on […] The post Pixels launches community hub for player-built games, tools and voting appeared first on BlockchainGamerBiz .
